description: 3D Floating Spatial Scroll Canvas — Full-Page Animated Motion Scrolling

userStories.title: Build SpatialScrollCanvas component with Three.js scene and lighting
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a high-performance WebGL canvas initialized with camera and cinematic ambient lighting in the background.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup PerspectiveCamera, WebGLRenderer with alpha support, and dual point lights (indigo/cyan)
Handle window resizing cleanly and cap pixel ratio at 1.75
userStories.notes: Built with PerspectiveCamera, dynamic ACESFilmic tone mapping, and point lights

userStories.title: Add 3D floating meshes with scroll-driven spatial animations
userStories.description: As I scroll down the page, 3D chrome spheres, geometric icosahedron wireframes, and glowing rings glide and rotate along the scroll path.
acceptanceCriteria: Create chrome metallic spheres, rotating wireframe icosahedrons, and glowing torus rings
Add floating star particle constellation (150-200 particles)
Implement smooth scroll lerp interpolation to drive 3D object positions and rotations
userStories.notes: Implemented chrome sphere, icosahedron, torus ring, octahedron, mini orbs, and 180 particles

userStories.title: Integrate SpatialScrollCanvas into page layout and calibrate milestones
userStories.description: As a user, the 3D canvas should be fixed in the background of page.tsx, seamlessly orchestrating elements across Hero, Projects, and Contact.
acceptanceCriteria: Mount SpatialScrollCanvas in src/app/page.tsx with fixed inset-0 z-0
Ensure content remains perfectly legible with appropriate opacity and pointer-events-none
Calibrate scroll progress smoothly from 0 to 1 across the total document height
userStories.notes: Mounted in page.tsx with pointer-events-none and smooth lerp interpolation

userStories.title: Add desktop mouse parallax, reduced-motion, and WebGL fallback
userStories.description: As a visitor, moving the mouse produces subtle 3D perspective tilt; reduced-motion preferences freeze motion; non-WebGL displays a static CSS fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop pointer move adds smooth parallax tilt to camera/meshes
Respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by freezing dynamic transforms
Graceful fallback if WebGL context is not supported
Full disposal of geometries, materials, and renderer on unmount
userStories.notes: Parallax pointer tracking, prefers-reduced-motion check, fallback div, and full disposal
